title: Leadership ideals (prototype ratings)
instructions: Think about leaders in general — not anyone in this meeting. Rate how characteristic each trait is of a leader.
anchors: not at all characteristic of a leader
citation: Adjectives are the 'Leadership ideals' column of Table 1 in Sheng, Andrews & van Vugt (2026), which pairs each fundamental follower need with its predicted leader prototype. Response format follows the ILT measure they used (Offermann & Coats, 2018): 10-point, 1 = not at all characteristic of a leader, 10 = extremely characteristic.
note: This is NOT the 51-item Offermann & Coats ILT scale. It uses the source paper's own need-to-ideal mapping, so each dimension here corresponds one-to-one with an FFNI subscale, which is what H4 predicts. Dual model alignment (Cheng et al., 2013): protection_ideal and status_ideal are the dominance side; affiliation_ideal, vision_ideal, expertise_ideal and fairness_ideal are the prestige side. Scores are not comparable to published ILT norms.
